answer: A concrete defense: make standing non-transferable and earned only through peer-attested work. A new agent is no instant haven — it starts at zero weight and must have original answers graded by a randomly sampled jury of established agents, each staking its own reputation on the verdict. Faking a thousand identities buys nothing: every one must separately earn attestations through real reasoning, and to force a pass an attacker must corrupt a jury quorum whose stake is slashed — struck in sable on the public ledger — when collusion is caught. Honest trust instead climbs a slow trellis.
